title: Conditional owner review: Daily access to the Platinum Live writer role

scope.target_source: Exact ARN supplied by the operator and present in the saved deployment receipt; this review made no live AWS call.
scope.daily_account_source: Daily official custom S3 storage documentation.

evidence_and_limits.observed_by_operator: The actual Daily storage verification reported role_assumption_denied. The IAM trust was inspected separately and matched the intended Daily account and ExternalId.
evidence_and_limits.not_observed: The contents, identifier, attachment ancestry and mutability of the effective RCP have not been read. The operator's current ListParents call and both ListPoliciesForTarget calls returned AccessDeniedException. A later result-formatting error does not change those observed API denials; this plan does not repeat the calls.
evidence_and_limits.hypothesis: The published AWS new-experience external-principal deny is a plausible cause, not a confirmed diagnosis.
evidence_and_limits.current_authorization_boundary: The user subsequently authorized owner-level Settings review and service completion. The review was performed, and AWS now reports PAID/ACTIVE after an owner account change. Advanced activation remains unsubmitted by the agent and requires owner root-email verification; actual organization policy content and mutability are still unverified.
evidence_and_limits.no_claim_of_resolution: A correct local trust policy and this proposed exception cannot establish that another applicable policy will permit STS or S3.

owner_review_gates: Read the effective RCP attachments at the account, every parent OU and organization root through an authorized owner or administrator; record exact policy IDs, content hashes and attachment scope.

Identify the specific applicable deny using policy content and available denial evidence. Also check other applicable RCPs, SCPs and IAM controls before attributing the failure to this published example.
Determine policy mutability and the identity authorized to edit it. The AWS-published new-experience RCP is explicitly documented as nonmodifiable.

If the actual blocker is that immutable AWS-managed policy, STOP. Request a supported narrow exception from the responsible AWS/account owner. Do not attempt UpdatePolicy, attach an Allow, detach policies, disable policy types, leave the organization, or activate advanced features as part of this plan.
Only if an editable customer-managed policy contains an equivalent deny, prepare a diff against its captured exact content; preserve every unrelated statement and its attachments.
Confirm the role ARN still matches exactly, and its trust still permits only the intended Daily AssumeRole relationship with ExternalId platinumcircles. Do not broaden trust or S3 permissions.

Review the concrete current-policy diff and rollback content with the owner before any mutation. An approval to inspect account settings is not approval to upgrade features, change billing or remove guardrails.
Validate the proposed RCP using current AWS-supported policy validation and the decision cases below. Local reasoning is not an AWS authorization simulation.

conditional_example.classification: Derived design for an editable policy only; not an export of the attached policy and not a complete replacement policy.
conditional_example.prerequisite: A qualified owner confirms that a mutable policy's relevant deny is semantically equivalent to the published DenyAnyoneOutsideMyOrgAndAWS statement. If any action, condition, resource scope or surrounding statement differs, adapt and re-review the exact diff rather than applying this example.
conditional_example.transformation: Keep the original non-STS action coverage and conditions. Separate STS denial by resource, principal account, ExternalId and other current role-scoped actions, so the reviewed exception is only the intended Daily AssumeRole path.
preservation_rules: The first fragment's non-STS action set, resource and conditions must match the captured original deny after separating only sts:*; use the actual action list, not this published snapshot, when preparing a later concrete diff.
Preserve the entire DenyAWSWhenItsNotMyOrgsSourceAccount statement, if present, byte for byte, including its STS coverage. Preserve every other statement and attachment without change.

Keep the original treatment of organization principals, AWS service principals and anonymous requests. This example does not change the published conditions defining the denied external authenticated class.
Do not place the Daily account exception into the non-STS statement or into a resource-wildcard condition that also exempts other roles.
All fragments use Deny and Principal '*'. RCP NotAction and NotPrincipal are unsupported. No Allow statement, policy detachment or policy-type disablement is proposed.

The current STS role-action catalog was reviewed on 2026-11-03. Recheck it before applying. The unchanged trust must still grant only sts:AssumeRole with the required ExternalId; no new session-tag, source-identity, context, SAML or web-identity grant is proposed.
semantics: For requests already matched by the original external-principal deny, sts:* remains denied on every resource other than the one exact role.
On the exact role, every external account except 291871421005 remains denied, even if it supplies the known ExternalId.
Daily requests to the exact role remain denied when ExternalId is absent or differs from platinumcircles. The role trust independently enforces the same value.

Other current role-scoped STS actions remain explicitly denied on that role. A matching Daily sts:AssumeRole request only passes this refactored deny; all other authorization layers must still permit it.
After a permitted AssumeRole, Daily uses the resulting role session. This does not grant Daily's original external identity direct S3 access or broaden the role's existing S3 policy.

decision_cases.case: Daily account; exact role; sts:AssumeRole; ExternalId platinumcircles
decision_cases.expected: No deny from the refactored external-principal statement; unchanged trust and every other applicable policy must still permit the request.

decision_cases.case: Daily account; exact role; wrong or missing ExternalId
decision_cases.expected: Denied by the scoped ExternalId deny and unchanged trust.

decision_cases.case: Another external account; exact role; correct ExternalId
Daily account; any other role; any STS action
decision_cases.expected: Denied by the sts:* NotResource restriction whenever the original external-principal conditions match.

decision_cases.case: Another external account; any other role; any STS action
decision_cases.expected: Same existing STS denial; no new exception.

decision_cases.case: Daily account; exact role; SAML, web identity, session tags, source identity or context action
decision_cases.expected: Denied by the explicit other-role-actions fragment; trust remains unchanged.

decision_cases.case: External principal; S3, KMS or any other original non-STS service
Principal with missing PrincipalOrgID and a present PrincipalARN
decision_cases.expected: Missing organization information does not bypass the external-principal conditions.

decision_cases.case: Organization principal, AWS service principal or anonymous request
decision_cases.expected: Treatment under the original conditions is preserved; no new permission is granted.

decision_cases.case: Another applicable RCP or the preserved AWS SourceOrgID deny still blocks the request
decision_cases.expected: Request stays denied; stop and review that distinct blocker. Do not broaden this exception.

execution_and_rollback_after_separate_ow.precondition: Policy identity, exact preimage hash, mutability, effective attachment scope and final diff have all been verified and approved.
execution_and_rollback_after_separate_ow.apply_scope: Only the reviewed statement refactor in the identified editable policy. Re-read its hash immediately before any write and stop on drift. No runnable mutation command or complete replacement policy is included here.
execution_and_rollback_after_separate_ow.verification: Read back the exact policy, compare unrelated statements and attachments, and rerun only the bounded Daily verify_storage operation. Record its enum-only receipt, room cleanup confirmation and, when authorized, fresh daily-co-test-upload.txt object metadata. Do not start a broadcast for this verification.
execution_and_rollback_after_separate_ow.rollback: Restore the exact captured prior policy content to the same verified policy ID if the approved change creates an unintended result. Preserve attachments and all unrelated resources.
execution_and_rollback_after_separate_ow.success_limit: Storage verification and removal of this denial are separate from playable HLS, CDN playback, replay and scale acceptance.

sources.supports: Published conditional baseline; managed new-experience RCP is not modifiable.
RCP Deny-only customer policies; Principal '*'; Action and NotResource; NotAction/NotPrincipal unsupported.
A deny anywhere in effective RCP ancestry cannot be overridden by another Allow.
Current STS role-scoped actions and ExternalId on AssumeRole.
Third-party role trust and ExternalId are separate required controls.
Daily account291871421005, domain-name ExternalId, documented S3 test object.

earlier_permission_request.action: Open AWS Settings for owner-level read-only review of the current account mode and available organization policy controls.
earlier_permission_request.reason: The authorized API identity cannot inspect the effective organization-policy ancestry, and automatic approval review previously rejected opening Settings under the narrower key-work authorization.
earlier_permission_request.permitted_result: Inspect and report the relevant current settings or owner handoff required; capture only nonsecret evidence needed to identify the policy control.
earlier_permission_request.separate_authorization_required: Any account upgrade, advanced-feature activation, billing change, policy mutation, detachment, disablement or other write remains outside this request.

latest_owner_review.next_step: Owner completes the concrete irreversible activation review and root-email verification if chosen. Then inspect effective policy content, scope and supported mutability before preparing any actual Daily exception. A plan upgrade is not evidence of provider acceptance.
